mapper.select: select id,title,pinned,active_run_id as activeRunId from t_capp_ai_session where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
select id,title,active_run_id as activeRunId,pinned from t_capp_ai_session where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} for update
mapper.update: update t_capp_ai_session set active_run_id=#{runId},updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and active_run_id is null
update t_capp_ai_session set active_run_id=null,updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and active_run_id=#{runId}
update t_capp_ai_session set title=#{title},updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and title in ('新会话','新对话')
update t_capp_ai_session set title=#{title},updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
update t_capp_ai_session set pinned=#{pinned},updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from t_capp_ai_summary where user_id=#{userId} and session_id in #{id}
delete from t_capp_ai_run where user_id=#{userId} and session_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select id,session_id as sessionId,status,resume_id as resumeId,input_text as inputText, application_id as applicationId,task_type as action, error_code as errorCode,model_calls as modelCalls,tool_calls as toolCalls,total_tokens as totalTokens, timestampdiff(second,created_at,current_timestamp) as ageSeconds from t_capp_ai_run where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: update t_capp_ai_run set status=#{status},error_code=#{errorCode},model_calls=#{modelCalls}, tool_calls=#{toolCalls},total_tokens=#{tokens},finished_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: select e.id,e.event_type as type,e.data_json as data from t_capp_ai_event e join t_capp_ai_run r on r.id=e.run_id where r.id=#{runId} and r.user_id=#{userId} and e.id > #{after} order by e.id limit 100
